AE.reduction: mean over batch, both views, spatial patches and DINO channels; average8 sampled physical transitions/update; one sampled h1..8 per transition
AE.latent: joint two-view latent16x64; consistency mean across batch/query/dim, not arbitrary per-camera tokens
AE.mask: only complete valid anchors and valid sampled horizons; no padded tail in training

optimizer.horizon_sampling: seeded permutation of (episode,valid_anchor,h1..8); identical C/D sequence
optimizer.master_parameters: official inflat_all utility, FP32 master over official mixed-FP16 model
optimizer.loss_scale_deviation: fixed conservative2^8 rather than official initial2^20 dynamic growth; train-only finite-gradient calibration; identical arms
optimizer.lambda_selection: frozen from original task; no per-task calibration or development tuning
optimizer.budget_reason: same600x8 physical transitions across all tasks; fixed compute, not convergence
optimizer.horizon_deviation: paired pilot h1..8 instead of official training h2..64; matches policy target support

policy.action: official mean normalized L1 over all valid Bx8x7; BF16 action labels in official forward
policy.auxiliary: mean L1(predicted Bx8x1024, normalized target) with common lambda
policy.mask: 8x7 all valid action elements;8 cumulative targets; only full-valid windows
policy.batch: 8 physical windows x2 appearances; micro8, accumulation2
policy.optimizer: AdamW single trainable group322589983 parameters; base LR2e-4 x multiplier; WD.01, betas.9/.999 eps1e-8
policy.scheduler: MultiStepLR milestone1200 gamma.1; no warmup; no decay reached this round

latent_metrics.effective_rank: SVD of sample-centered latent; exp entropy of normalized squared singular values
latent_metrics.different: only different-episode pairs in same fixed development sample
latent_metrics.mean_scope: training mean is saved; full development mean vector not retained

limitations: AE development measurements exist only at frozen reference and final600, no invented intermediate curve
No new physical probe; source labels are same-recorded-state simulator bowl position and finger qpos, not external real-world ground truth
Cookie comparison uses same metric definitions but different tasks/distributions; correlation is not causality
Policy LR comparison cannot resolve AE lambda_inv choice, AE convergence or AE seed stability
